lens: Skeptic. Every detail is treated as wrong until a real photo shows it right. Fabrics were judged on photo-vs-render crops at matched physical scale: y_47306 middle/left/right at ~640/410/900 px/m against studio e4/e1, y_47300 at row distance against q15 resampled by 62/135, and sans_14 at ~945 px/m against tex_y_fleck. Official ANA photos decide colour and finish; real in-service photos (sans_*, fr57325_*) decide geometry. Lighting and the QA camera framing are noted but not scored.

issues.title: Dash mosaic now reads as a brick wall with dark grout; the real fabric is tone-on-tone horizontal dash streaks with no seams
issues.evidence: mosaic_cmp.png (/tmp/claude-0/raterA12): y_47306 R at 900 px/m against e4 x1.45. Photo |gy|/|gx| 1.50, p10/50/90 38/73/148, B/R 2.08. Render 1.03, 57/94/142, 1.83. The render shows dark 1 px seams round every block, and the dash fill aliases into isotropic speckle. y_47300 seat-4 pan (y00pan4.png): blocks about 2:1 wide, defined only by dash density, low contrast, no grout.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_mosaic(): seam strength 0.35 -> 0 (block edges only from the density change). Make the dashes long and fat enough to survive mipmaps: dash height 1 -> 2 px (rows every 3 px = 2.3 mm), lognormal length median 4 -> 9 mm (sigma 0.5, clip 3-22 mm), gap 0.5-1.5 -> 1-2.5 mm. Blocks NI, NJ 7, 11 -> 6, 11 (about 33 x 18 mm, ~1.8:1) with no brick offset, and jitter each block's x-extent by ±20 % so edges do not align into a grid. Density set {0.12, 0.30, 0.55} -> {0.25, 0.45, 0.65} at lift [4.6, 4.9, 5.3]. Darken the ground (ground = 0.88 + 0.06*t/mean) so p10 lands near 0.55x the median. Check: blur 1.5 px at 900 px/m, |gy|/|gx| >= 1.4 and no 1 px dark lines.

issues.title: Diamond fabric is soft polka-diamond blobs on a strict lattice; the photo has crisp serrated star/diamond figures in irregular vertical chains
issues.evidence: diam_cmp.png: y_47306 L and y_47302 M against e1 and e3 at ~420 px/m. Light area above 1.25x the median: photo 0.24 / 0.25, render 0.36 / 0.34. High-pass std 0.25 against 0.32. The render figures have a 1 px gaussian edge plus a mottled fill on 0.0863 m quincunx sites, all the same size. The photo figures have sharp stepped edges, pointed tips (arrow/star) and pale interiors close to the ground tone, and they vary in size and spacing.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_diamond(): drop the GaussianBlur(1.0) on m (keep the 5 mm ceil steps hard). Raise the mottle floor (clip 0.3 -> 0.6) so interiors are evenly pale. Lower the lift 4.0 -> 3.0 so figures are ~1.5x the ground, not 1.9x. Shrink hd 0.034-0.039 -> 0.028-0.036, randomised per site, and jitter each site by ±6 mm so the quincunx breaks up. Add pointed tips by making each figure the union of the diamond and a 5 mm-step cross with arm length 0.6 hd (kasuri arrow). Target a light fraction of 0.24-0.27 at 1.25x the median.

issues.title: Head-on headrest covers are still as bright as the fabric (0.91-1.15 vs 0.54-0.75)
issues.evidence: q15 cover/fabric luminance per seat 0.91/1.04/1.15/1.00. y_47300 0.68/0.75/0.54/0.65. Covers #3a4268-#4a5277 against #1c2238-#393e5b. q16 is right (0.69 = y_47301), so the q15 excess is the specular lobe of a near-vertical plate under the ceiling light.
issues.fix: Geometry rather than colour: in 09a_econ.js, tip the plate's foot further forward. Change the plate SEC z values to -0.118 / -0.110 / -0.104 / -0.1025 / -0.1015 / -0.0985 (foot ~2 cm proud of the top), so its normal faces ~5 deg down and away from the ceiling light. Extend the plate start 0.55 -> 0.525 to fix the flap drop (target 26-29 % of the pad, y_47306). If that is not enough, set the SEATMAT.yCover line to c '#3d4360' (one shared line).

issues.title: Tick columns are still too weak at row distance, and the close-up darks are too deep
issues.evidence: q15 tick seats resampled to y_47300 scale: column CV 0.090 / 0.095 against 0.172 / 0.177, p90/p50 1.31 against 1.47-1.50. Close up (tick_cmp.png, e4 vs y_47306 middle): p10 28 against 56, p10/p50 0.41 against 0.62, so the inter-column channels go near-black and read as knit cable.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py synth_y_tick(): envelope amplitude 0.22 -> 0.35, keeping the 15.5 mm period. Before the envelope, lift the darks with ratio = 0.35*mean + 0.65*ratio on luminance (the p10/p50 target is 0.6), so the columns show by stroke density rather than black channels. Check q15: tick column CV of about 0.15.

issues.title: Seat pans are still pale and desaturated
issues.evidence: Studio pan B/R 1.52-1.55 against y_47300 / 47302 / 47303 1.74-1.90. The pans are the most visible fabric surface in y_47302 and y_47303.

issues.title: Armrest is still a box on a vertical post, and the aisle-end panel is a solid white triangle
issues.evidence: e3 and e7, against y_47303 (one J sweep from the nose into the lower rail, open underneath in regular rows).
issues.fix: econUnit: replace the front armPost loft (SEC 0.30-0.62 at z -0.37 to -0.395) with a 5-section loft that follows the arm nose (y 0.64, z -0.40) round a 6 cm radius to (y 0.42, z -0.36), in SEATMAT.arm. Block-end panel: SEC heights capped at 0.40 (drop the 0.62 section) unless opts.bulkhead.

issues.title: Fleck petals are identical rice grains; the photo's chips vary from dots to 7 mm slivers
issues.evidence: Length IQR: tile 5.0-6.1 mm, sans_14 3.9-6.7 mm. Petal brightness is fixed at lift 7.0 and the photo's is varied. Row-distance ground too light (p10 56 vs 37).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck(): a = lognormal(log(2.6 mm), 0.35), with 15 % of petals as 1-1.5 mm dots. Per-petal lift = 7.0 * uniform(0.6, 1.1). Ground 0.94 -> 0.90 baseline (darker relative to the flecks). Darken the yFabricD photoBase colour about 10 % (#4a5679 -> #43506f).

issues.title: Contact-darkening strips read as hard black gap lines
issues.evidence: e1 and e4: crisp #1d2238 6 mm strips down both back edges. y_47306: a soft graded crease.
issues.fix: In the contact loft, use c '#2a3150' at 0.010 width and push it 1.5 mm behind the fabric surface (z -0.0515 / -0.0465 / -0.0355) so it peeks out as a shadow, not a line.

issues.title: Tray placard still reads as a 3-port box; the pocket flap is white, not light grey
issues.evidence: e5 and q18: three equal grey squares on a white box. sans_15 / 17: a landscape placard with two different dark pictograms and a yellow mark. sans_23: the flap is light-grey leatherette (~#c4c5c3) with piping; the render's #bdc0c4 reads near-white under the studio light.
issues.fix: Placard 0.055 x 0.022 -> 0.07 x 0.024, with two dark quads (#30333a) of 0.016 x 0.014 and 0.012 x 0.016 and one #d8b030 0.006 quad. Pocket flap c '#bdc0c4' -> '#aeb0b2'.

questionsForUser: On the diamond variant: are the figures closed diamonds or pointed kasuri arrow/star shapes? y_47302 middle and y_47306 left suggest stars in vertical chains, but both photos are oblique. A straight-on photo of a diamond-back seat would settle the figure shape and pitch.
Mosaic: is it only ever a pan/pad fabric, or are some backs fully mosaic? y_47306 right and y_47303 near suggest mosaic backs, but y_47300 shows it only on a pan.
Is the safety card's purple header visible above the pocket on every seat, or only when the card sits high (sans_20 / 21)?
